partners.mechanism_chain: GUF1 (HGNC:10588) —DISRUPTS→ Synaptic vesicle cycle (GO:0007275); FBXO28 (HGNC:29970) —DISRUPTS→ Synaptic vesicle cycle (GO:0007275); Synaptic vesicle cycle (GO:0007275) —LEADS_TO→ Regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential (GO:0003003); GRIN1 (HGNC:4577) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential (GO:0003003); Regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential (GO:0003003) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); Regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential (GO:0003003) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); GUF1 (HGNC:10588) —LEADS_TO→ Apoptosis (GO:0006915); FBXO28 (HGNC:29970) —LEADS_TO→ Apoptosis (GO:0006915); Apoptosis (GO:0006915) —LEADS_TO→ Regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential (GO:0003003). Mutations in GUF1 and FBXO28 (shared genes for EIEE3 and GDEE) disrupt the synaptic vesicle cycle (GO:0007275), impacting neurotransmission and neuronal excitability. Concurrently, mutations in GRIN1 (causal for GDEE) also disrupt synaptic function. Both pathways converge on the regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential (GO:0003003), leading to phenotypes of seizures (HP:0001250) and developmental delay (HP:0001263). Furthermore, disruption of GUF1 and FBXO28 can also lead to increased apoptosis (GO:0006915), which further contributes to the dysregulation of neuronal function.
